technical-data.invention-title: MECHANICAL DEVICE WITH SEALING MEANS AND METHOD FOR MOUNTING THE SEALING MEANS
DISPOSITIF MECANIQUE A MOYEN D'ETANCHEITE ET PROCEDE DE MONTAGE DU MOYEN D'ETANCHEITE

abstract.p: A mechanical device (10) having a shaft (300), a sealing device (100) for sealing around the shaft, a housing (500), and a first abutment means (400). The sealing device (100) has a carrier means (110, 120) on which a plurality of resilient sealing elements (140, 150) are arranged. The mechanical device further has an enclosure means (130, 130'). The sealing device (100) has a first sealing element (140) with an inner dimension, which is larger than the outer dimension of the shaft (300). The enclosure means (130), 130') at least partially encloses the first sealing element (140). After the sealing means (100) has been mounted and compressingly fastened in the mechanical device (10), the first sealing element is compressed in a first direction (A), axially along the shaft, and expanded in a second direction (B), radially towards the shaft. The first sealing element (140) is thus brought to a sealing engagement with the shaft.

Un dispositif mécanique (10) comprend un arbre (300), un dispositif d'étanchéité (100) assurant l'étanchéité autour de l'arbre, un logement (500), et un premier moyen d'aboutement (400). Le dispositif d'étanchéité (100) comprend un moyen porteur (110, 120) sur lequel sont agencés une pluralité d'éléments d'étanchéité résilients (140, 150). Le dispositif mécanique comprend également un moyen formant enceinte (130, 130'). Le dispositif d'étanchéité (100) comprend un premier élément d'étanchéité (140) présentant une dimension intérieure, laquelle est supérieure à la dimension extérieure de l'arbre (300). Le moyen formant enceinte (130, 130') renferme au moins partiellement le premier élément d'étanchéité (140). Une fois le moyen d'étanchéité (100) monté et fixé en compression dans le dispositif mécanique (10), le premier élément d'étanchéité est comprimé dans un premier sens (A), axialement le long de l'arbre, et dilaté dans un second sens (B), radialement vers l'arbre. Le premier élément d'étanchéité (140) est ainsi amené en contact d'étanchéité avec l'arbre.

description.p: TITLE :
Mechanical device with sealing means and method for mounting the sealing means
TECHNICAL FIELD:
The present invention relates to a mechanical device having a sealing means and a method of mounting the sealing means to the mechanical device.
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION:

Different types of sealing means for mechanical devices are known. Special sealing means are furthermore required when sealing a rotating shaft from its housing, i.e. non-rotating surrounding parts of the mechanical device. In GB-A-2 137 702, an oil sealing means is shown which, on the one hand, is arranged to seal against the surface of a rotating shaft and, on the other hand, is arranged to seal against the non-rotating housing. A cylindrical elastomeric sleeve is adapted to be received over the outside diameter of the shaft, to seal against the shaft. A further traditional sealing means seal against the housing. The sleeve has to be pressed on the shaft, because of the tight fit required between the sleeve and the shaft. The sealing material of the sleeve is therefore easily cut or otherwise damaged during this operation, especially if the shaft is provided with sharp cornered splines, of the same diameter as the shaft, at the outgoing end of the shaft.
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION:
The object of the present invention is to provide a mechanical device, which has an easy to mount sealing means .

A further object of the invention is to provide a mechanical device, which has a more effective sealing
means,
These objects are achieved with a mechanical device according to the invention, whose features are disclosed in the appended claim 1.
Still a further object of the invention is to provide a method of mounting the sealing means according to the invention to a mechanical device.
This object is achieved with a method of mounting the sealing means to the mechanical device according to claim 8.
This object is also achieved with a method of mounting the sealing means to the mechanical device according to claim 9.
Further preferred embodiments are disclosed in the appended dependent claims.
BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS:
The invention will be described more in the following with some preferred embodiments whilst reference is made to the accompanying drawings, in which:

Fig. 2 is a schematic sectional side view of one part of a sealing means used with a mechanical device according to a second embodiment of the invention.
PREFERRED EMBODIMENTS:

A mechanical device 10 according to the invention is shown in Fig. 1. The device 10 comprises a housing 500 and a shaft 300. The shaft 300 is rotatably arranged in the housing 500 and is advantageously provided with splines (not shown) for enhanced engagement with drive units (not shown) or the like.

The device 10 further comprises a sealing device 100 for sealing around the shaft 300 and against the housing 500. A first abutment means 400 is provided in the mechanical device 10 to function as a stop/anvil for the sealing device 100.

The sealing device 100 comprises a first carrier part 110 and a second carrier part 120 on which a plurality of sealing elements 140, 150, 160 are arranged. A first sealing element 140 is arranged on the first carrier part 110, to seal against the shaft 300. The sealing surface of the first sealing element 140 may be smooth or patterned, e.g. ribbed, and the material used is preferably a resilient material. A second sealing element 150 is arranged on the second carrier part 120, to seal against the housing 500. The second carrier part 120 further has a third sealing element 160, which is arranged to seal between the first carrier part 110 and the second carrier part 120. The third sealing element 160 is advantageously held in sealing engagement by a spring means 170, e.g. a garter spring.
Thus, the first carrier part 110 is arranged to rotate with the shaft 300 whilst the second carrier part 120 is arranged to be held still with respect to the housing 500.

The splines of the shaft 300 are generally formed having
sharp edges, which could easily cut the first sealing element 140 during mounting of the sealing device 100 on the shaft 300. For that reason, the first sealing element 140 has an inner dimension, which is larger than the outer dimension of the shaft 300. Thus, the first sealing element 140, and the sealing device 100, may be mounted over the shaft 300 without risking cutting the first sealing element on the sharp splines.

The mechanical device 10 further comprises a first enclosure means 130, which at least partially encloses the first sealing element 140. When the sealing means 100 is mounted and compressingly fastened in the mechanical device 10, the first sealing element 140 is compressed in a first direction A, axially along the shaft 300, and expanded in a second direction B, radially towards the shaft. Thus, a first contact surface 180 of the first sealing element 140 is in contact with the first abutment means 400 and a second contact surface 190 of the first sealing element 140 is in sealing engagement with the shaft 300. It is possible, but not necessary, to arrange a sealing engagement also between the first contact surface 180 and the first abutment means 400.

In this way, the first sealing element 140 is forced into a sealing engagement with the shaft 300 when mounted in the mechanical device 10. The expansion of the first sealing element 140 in the second direction B is greatly enhanced by the first enclosure means 130 because the first enclosure means prevents the expansion of the first sealing means 140 in directions opposite to the first direction A and the second direction B.

The first enclosure means 130 is arranged on the first carrier part 110, according to the embodiment shown in
Fig. 1 .

The first carrier part 110 is prevented from sliding along the shaft 300 in the first direction A by a second abutment means 600. Thus, the second abutment means 600 holds and compressingly fastens the sealing means 100 in the mechanical device 10. Similarly, the second carrier part 120 is prevented from sliding along the shaft 300 in the first direction A by a third abutment means 610.

Another embodiment of a mechanical device 10 according to the invention is shown in Fig. 2. A second enclosure means 130' is, in this embodiment, arranged on the first abutment means 400. The functioning of the second enclosure means 130' is similar to what has been described regarding the first enclosure means 130 according to Fig. 1. No enclosure means is thus present on the first carrier part 110 according to this embodiment. All other features are similar to the embodiment described with reference to Fig. 1.

According to one preferred embodiment of the invention, the first abutment means 400, the second abutment means 600 and the third abutment means 610 are bearing elements, e.g. ball or roller bearings journalling the shaft 300. Alternatively, the first abutment means 400 may be an enlarged diameter part of the shaft 300, and may thus be integrally formed with the shaft.

A first method of mounting the sealing device 100 in a mechanical device 10 according to the invention includes the following steps: arranging the first abutment means 400 onto the shaft 300, - arranging the first sealing element 140, and the first carrier means 110 and the second carrier means
120, over the shaft 300, arranging the second abutment means 600 onto the shaft 300, fastening the sealing means 100 in the mechanical device 10, by compressing the second abutment means 600 towards the first abutment means 400, thus compressing the first sealing element 140 in the first direction A, axially along the shaft 300, and expanding the first sealing element in the second direction B, radially towards the shaft, thus bringing a first sealing surface 180 of the first sealing element 140 in sealing engagement with the first abutment means 400 and a second sealing surface 190 of the first sealing element 140 in sealing engagement with the shaft 300, - fastening the second abutment means 600 on the shaft 300.

A second method of mounting the sealing device 100 in a mechanical device 10 according to the invention includes the following steps: arranging the first abutment means 400 onto the shaft 300, arranging the first carrier part 110 onto the shaft 300, - arranging the second carrier part 120 on the first carrier part 110, arranging the second abutment means 600 onto the shaft 300, fastening the sealing means 100 in the mechanical device 10, by compressing the second abutment means 600 towards the first abutment means 400, thus compressing the first sealing element 140 in the first direction A, axially along the shaft 300, and expanding the first sealing element in the second direction B, radially towards the shaft, thus bringing a first sealing surface 180 of the first sealing element 140 in sealing
engagement with the first abutment means 400 and a second sealing surface 190 of the first sealing element 140 in sealing engagement with the shaft 300, fastening the second abutment means 600 on the shaft 300.

The sealing elements may be fastened to the respective carrier part by crimping or bonding. The carrier parts are usually made of steel, e.g. steel stampings, but may be aluminium, brass or the like. Suitable materials for the sealing elements are rubbers, e.g. nitrile rubbers, natural rubbers, fluorelastomers, carboxylated nitriles, hydrin rubbers, silicone rubbers etc. For harder sealing material, a fluorocarbon resin may be used, e.g. a polymer of tetrafluoroethylene (TPE) filled with glass fibres, carbon or other materials.

The invention is neither limited to the description above nor to the examples shown on the drawings, but may be varied within the scope of the appended claims. For example, an arrangement where an additional expanding sealing element is arranged to seal against the housing, in addition to the expanding sealing means sealing against the shaft, is also possible using the sealing device according to the invention. An additional enclosure means will then have to be furnished for the additional expanding sealing element, co-operating with an additional abutment means arranged to act as a stop for the additional expanding sealing element. The sealing device may comprise a one-part carrier means as opposed to the two-part embodiment shown in the Figs .

claim.claim-text: 1. A mechanical device (10) comprising a shaft (300), a sealing device (100) for sealing around the shaft, a housing (500), and a first abutment means (400), where the sealing device (100) comprises carrier means (110, 120) on which a plurality of sealing elements (140, 150, 160) are arranged, characterised in that the mechanical device further comprises an enclosure means (130, 130') and the sealing device (100) further comprises a first sealing element (140) having an inner dimension which is larger than the outer dimension of the shaft (300), wherein the enclosure means (130, 130') at least partially encloses the first sealing element (140), so that, after the sealing means (100) has been mounted and compressingly fastened in the mechanical device (10), the first sealing element is compressed in a first direction (A) axially along the shaft and expanded in a second direction (B) radially towards the shaft so that a first contact surface (180) of the first sealing element (140) is in contact with the first abutment means (400) and a second contact surface (190) of the first sealing element (140) is in sealing engagement with the shaft (300).
2. The device according to claim 1, characterised in that the enclosure means (130) is arranged on the carrier means (110, 120).

3. The device according to claim 1, characterised in that the enclosure means (130') is arranged on the first
abutment means (400).

4. The device according to claims 1 to 3, characterised in that the carrier means (110, 120) comprises a first carrier part (110) and a second carrier part (120), wherein the first carrier part (110) carries the first sealing element (140), which is arranged to seal against the shaft (300), the second carrier part (120) carries a second sealing element (150), which is arranged to seal against the housing (500), and a third sealing element (160), which is arranged to seal between the first carrier part (110) and the second carrier part (120).

5. The device according to claim 4, characterised in that the first carrier part (110) is arranged to rotate with the shaft (300) and the second carrier part (120) is arranged to be held still with respect to the housing (500).
6. The device according to claims 1 to 5, characterised in that the first abutment means (400) is a bearing.
7. The device according to claims 1 to 5, characterised in that the first abutment means (400) is an enlarged diameter part of the shaft (300).

8. A method of mounting a sealing device (100) in a mechanical device (10) according to claims 1 to 7, characterised by the following steps: arranging the first abutment means (400) on the shaft (300), arranging the first sealing element (140), and the first carrier means (110) and the second carrier means (120), over the shaft (300),
arranging the second abutment means (600) onto the shaft (300), fastening the sealing means (100) in the mechanical device (10), by compressing the second abutment means (600) towards the first abutment means (400), thus compressing the first sealing element (140) in the first direction (A), axially along the shaft (300), and expanding the first sealing element in the second direction (B), radially towards the shaft, thus bringing a first contact surface (180) of the first sealing element (140) in contact with the first abutment means (400) and a second contact surface (190) of the first sealing element (140) in sealing engagement with the shaft (300), - fastening the second abutment means (600) on the shaft (300).

9. A method of mounting a sealing device (100) in a mechanical device (10) according to claims 4 to 7, characterised by the following steps: arranging the first abutment means (400) onto the shaft (300), arranging the first carrier part (110) onto the shaft (300), - arranging the second carrier part (120) on the first carrier part (110), arranging the second abutment means (600) onto the shaft (300), fastening the sealing means (100) in the mechanical device (10), by compressing the second abutment means (600) towards the first abutment means (400), thus compressing the first sealing element (140) in the first direction (A), axially along the shaft (300), and expanding the first sealing element in the second direction (B), radially towards the shaft, thus bringing a first contact surface (180) of the first sealing
element (140) in contact with the first abutment means (400) and a second contact surface (190) of the first sealing element (140) in sealing engagement with the shaft (300), fastening the second abutment means (600) on the shaft (300).
